Overview.Name: Triveni
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Mostly vegetarian, avoids non-veg on Monday and Thursday

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable fry
Meal_2 (Dinner - light): Option 2: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Vegetable soup + egg bhurji (2 eggs)

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid fried outside foods during stress eating moments.
Follow vegetarian meals on Monday and Thursday.
Start meals with paneer, curd or eggs before eating rice.
Field work needs stable energy, so avoid skipping meals.
Simple meals followed consistently will improve energy and body composition.
